 ESPN NBA Full Court Press: ESPN tips off its coverage of the 2026-27 season with back-to-back doubleheaders on Wednesday and Thursday
 Press Release
 October 19, 2026
 Author
 Ronce Rajan 
 Contact(s)
 Ben Cafardo
 ben.cafardo@espn.com 
 Ronce Rajan
 ronce.rajan@espn.com 
 Copy Text to Clipboard Summary
 Four-game Opening Week slate tips off ESPN’s 2026-27 NBA coverage 
 Giannis Antetokounmpo debuts with the Heat; LeBron James makes his Philadelphia home debut 
 NBA Tip-Off and Inside the NBA return as Ernie Johnson, Charles Barkley, Kenny Smith and Shaquille O’Neal provide pregame, halftime and postgame analysis both nights 
 ESPN tips off Opening Week presented by Wendy’s for the 2026–27 NBA regular season with back-to-back nights of doubleheaders presented by State Farm on Wednesday, October 21 and Thursday, October 22.
 On Wednesday,the Minnesota Timberwolves, led by Anthony Edwards and newly-acquired LaMelo Ball, visit the Miami Heat and two-time Kia NBA MVP Giannis Antetokounmpo, who makes his official Heat debut, at 7:30 p.m. ET on ESPN. Mike Breen will provide play-by-play alongside Richard Jefferson and Tim Legler , with Lisa Salters reporting.
 Following the opener, the new-look Los Angeles Lakers and Luka Dončić host the Golden State Warriors and two-time Kia NBA MVP Stephen Curry at 10 p.m. on ESPN. Dave Pasch calls the action with Doris Burke , while Malika Andrews reports from the sideline.
 NBA Tip-Off presented by Eli Lilly  precedes the doubleheader at 6:30 p.m. on ESPN, featuring  Ernie Johnson ,  Charles Barkley ,  Kenny Smith  and  Shaquille O’Neal .  Inside the NBA presented by Eli Lilly  airs immediately following the conclusion of the final game. Both shows are produced by TNT Sports.
 Thursday features another star-studded doubleheader on ESPN, beginning at 7 p.m., as the Cleveland Cavaliers and Donovan Mitchell visit the Philadelphia 76ers and four-time Kia NBA MVP LeBron James in Philadelphia’s home opener and James’ regular-season home debut with the franchise. The returning team of Breen, Jefferson, Legler and Salters has the call.
 The nightcap features a clash of Western Conference contenders as the Denver Nuggets and three-time Kia NBA MVP Nikola Jokić visit the Oklahoma City Thunder and reigning two-time Kia NBA MVP Shai Gilgeous-Alexander at 9:30 p.m. Ryan Ruocco and Jeremy Lin will call the action, with Katie George reporting from courtside.
 NBA Tip-Off presented by Eli Lilly begins Thursday coverage at 6 p.m. with the returning team of Johnson, Smith, O’Neal and Barkley. Inside the NBA presented by Eli Lilly follows doubleheader.
 All ESPN NBA games are also available to stream via the ESPN App.
